arguments.body: Hello Amelia, thanks for letting us know. Your tap is already booked in under job R-4801, with Swift Plumbing & Heating coming on Thursday 15 October, 8am-12pm. We haven't opened a second job, but I've added your update (that it's worse and now drips constantly) to the existing one so the plumber knows. In the meantime, you can turn off the small isolation valves under the sink if it gets worse, and put a bowl under the drip. If water starts to leak out anywhere else or you can't control it, please call us straight away. Kind regards, Mare & Co
